::: {#def-set-partition}
#### Partition of a set

Let $S$ be a set.
A **partition** of $S$ [@wikipedia_partition_of_a_set]
is a collection $\mathcal{C}$ (@def-collection) of subsets of $S$
such that

- every set in $\mathcal{C}$ is nonempty;
- any two different sets in $\mathcal{C}$ are disjoint: their intersection (@def-intersection) is empty;
- every element of $S$ is in some set in $\mathcal{C}$.

So each element of $S$ is in exactly one set in $\mathcal{C}$.

:::
